title: Finland: 27.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €996,800 a year
markdown:
# Finland: 27.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €996,800 a year

> Closes 27.1 of 65.5 missing patients a year (41%) · €996,800 of €1.00M · €3,200 left: less than the next measure costs

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. By county it runs from 18 in Lapland to 36 in Vantaa and Kerava. Bringing every county below the national share up to it is about 66 patients a year; 50 of them are in the 7 counties that are below it by more than chance. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, where 30.4 of 100 are treated to cure, about 123.1 patients a year are missing. [^care_curative] [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 27.0% to 27.9% by 2028: 27.1 more patients a year (range 0.0–42.5), for €996,800 a year, about €37,000 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 41% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (65.5 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | County | Funded measures | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Lapland** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €174,000 | 4.9 |
| 2 | **Kymenlaakso** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €117,640 | 3.4 |
| 3 | **Satakunta** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists | €121,280 | 3.3 |
| 4 | **North Karelia** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €114,400 | 2.8 |
| 5 | **Southwest Finland** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €67,480 | 2.3 |
| 6 | **Kanta-Häme** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €64,840 | 2.2 |
| 7 | **South Karelia** | Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €97,500 | 2.0 |
| 8 | **South Savo** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €60,920 | 1.8 |
| 9 | **North Ostrobothnia** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €44,000 | 1.7 |
| 10 | **Kainuu** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment | €79,900 | 1.2 |
| 11 | **North Savo** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €27,640 | 1.0 |
| 12 | **Central Ostrobothnia** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment | €27,200 | 0.5 |
| | **Total** | | **€996,800** | **27.1 (0.0–42.5)** |

Each county's own plan lists the owner, the first step and the measure for every action. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €17.4M a year; modelled to avoid 29.9 deaths a year (6.8–77.9). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 27.0% (2019–2023, measured) → 27.9% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The €3,200 left cannot buy anything more. [^model] The cheapest measure that would still add something is fitness testing and training in South Karelia, and it costs EUR 19,750 a year. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers needs a national decision. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 2,303 deaths a year in Finland, and this plan is modelled to avoid 4.1 of them (range 0.0-12.7). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Effect figures are a range, not a probability: the lowest and highest values when every assumption moves together from its lower to its upper bound. No trial measured them. [^model]
- Shares are not adjusted for stage at diagnosis, fitness and other illness, histology, how the cancer was found, smoking or treatment recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- A check found that 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance. [^model]

removed.sentence: More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision.
removed.reason: The clause 'More would come from' is unsupported: the material only lists screening as needing a national decision and gives no effect. The clause was cut, the supported remainder kept, and [^model] added.

removed.sentence: Ranking measures by deaths avoided would also add more. [^model]
removed.reason: Not in the material. It only says that measures shortening the pathway are counted under the deaths objective, not that ranking by deaths would add more.

removed.sentence: The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used in this plan.
removed.reason: The material calls the clock a secondary view and not a headline number, but never says it is not used in the plan. The sentence was cut and the clock named in the next sentence so that it still reads clearly.

flagged.sentence: The €3,200 left cannot buy anything more.
flagged.reason: It carries a figure but had no source marker. Added [^model], since the figure comes from the plan's saturation note.

written_sections: What more money buys, and what it cannot
draft_markdown:
## The gap
Of 100 lung cancer patients in Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. By county it runs from 18 in Lapland to 36 in Vantaa and Kerava. Bringing every county below the national share up to it is about 66 patients a year; 50 of them are in the 7 counties that are below it by more than chance. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, where 30.4 of 100 are treated to cure, about 123.1 patients a year are missing. [^care_curative] [^model]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot
The €3,200 left cannot buy anything more. The cheapest measure that would still add something is fitness testing and training in South Karelia, and it costs EUR 19,750 a year. [^model] More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision. Ranking measures by deaths avoided would also add more. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 2,303 deaths a year in Finland, and this plan is modelled to avoid 4.1 of them (range 0.0-12.7). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits
- Effect figures are a range, not a probability: the lowest and highest values when every assumption moves together from its lower to its upper bound. No trial measured them. [^model]
- Shares are not adjusted for stage at diagnosis, fitness and other illness, histology, how the cancer was found, smoking or treatment recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used in this plan. A check found that 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance. [^model]
